thread:
leah: quick sync on Parallel Toolflows MVP prioritization. Two hot customer asks: per-tool SLA preferences and deterministic retrying across parallel calls.

diego: both are common. propose we expose soft_timeout + hard_deadline, and a simple "priority_weight" int to allocate retries proportionally. keep config surface small.

nora: thumbs up. also need a clear partial response shape so clients can resume or stitch late arrivals.

pat: for MVP can we restrict late arrivals to an async webhook path? sync mode returns partial, async posts final. cancel endpoint is post-MVP.

leah: yes. MVP scope: client-specified soft_timeout_ms, platform hard_deadline_ms cap, per-call timeout_ms, priority_weight, root retry_budget, late_result_policy (drop|webhook). no ordering guarantees.

diego: API sample (SDK):
```json
{ "input": "Summarize", "soft_timeout_ms": 1000, "retry_budget": 2, "late_result_policy": "webhook", "calls": [ { "id": "p1", "tool": "scrape", "timeout_ms": 800, "priority_weight": 5 }, { "id": "p2", "tool": "safety", "timeout_ms": 200, "priority_weight": 1 } ] }
```

nora: response shape must include per-call status, attempts, latency_ms, error_code. example: {request_id, partial:true, results:[{id,status,attempts,latency_ms,output}], retry_info}.

pat: observability before GA: per-call attempts, p95 latency, percent_partial, late_arrival_rate, and traces with per-call spans. QA includes flaky-tool harness.

leah: rollout: gated feature-flag, beta with 3 customers. exclude hedging, transactional rollback, and async cancel for MVP. owners: product=leah, infra=diego, sdk=nora, cs=pat. I'll write the decision doc and link when ready.

ops-bot: feature flag created: parallel-toolflow.beta for staging.

leah: thanks, will follow up on docs and examples.
